verdict.rationale: AMD's ROCm documentation explicitly lists the AMD Radeon RX 9070 XT (gfx1201) as a supported target on its PyTorch and JAX install pages. The Radeon ROCm hub also lists 9000-series GPUs for Linux (PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX, ONNX) and Windows (PyTorch), with vLLM and llama.cpp support. Missing for 10: no explicit entry for this card in the core ROCm/HIP compatibility matrix in the evidence, and no independent hands-on report of compute workloads running on it.
